Meta.title: Apartment Ivanka · Top-floor apartment near the beach on Čiovo, Trogir
Meta.description: Top-floor holiday apartment with a sea-view balcony for up to 5 guests in Mastrinka on Čiovo island: a 3-minute walk to the beach, 3.5 km from Trogir, 5 km from Split Airport. Air conditioning, free Wi-Fi, free private parking. Book directly with the hosts — no platform fees.

Apartment.title: The whole top floor, just for you
Apartment.intro: 70 m² under the roof, a sea-view balcony and everything you need for relaxed days on the Adriatic.
Apartment.body1: Two bedrooms — one with a double bed, one with a double and a single — plus a sofa bed in the living room: space for up to five guests, ideal for families. The kitchenette with dining table comes with a coffee machine and kettle, and morning coffee tastes best on the balcony overlooking the bay.
Apartment.body2: The apartment sits on the top floor with the cosy sloped ceilings typical of an attic — very tall guests should mind their head in the second bedroom, while the air conditioning keeps everything pleasantly cool in summer. The pebble beach is a few minutes' walk downhill, a supermarket is just around the corner, and your free parking spot is right at the house.

Location.title: Mastrinka on Čiovo — the sea on your doorstep, Trogir around the corner
Location.intro: A quiet spot above the bay on Čiovo island — with the beach and a supermarket within walking distance.
Location.body: The apartment is in Mastrinka on the island of Čiovo, right above the bay of Trogir. The pebble beach is a few minutes' walk down the hill, and a supermarket is close by. Trogir's UNESCO old town with its konobas and the Kamerlengo fortress is a few minutes away by car, and Split Airport is only 5 km — perfect for a stress-free arrival and departure.

checkin.q: What are the check-in and check-out times?
checkin.a: Check-in is between 3 pm and 6 pm, check-out between 8 am and 10 am. We are flexible when the schedule allows — just ask.

parking.a: Yes, there is free private parking at the house.

beach.a: The Mastrinka pebble beach is only about a 3-minute walk away — perfect for a morning swim. More beaches on Čiovo are an easy drive away.

family.q: Is the apartment suitable for children?
family.a: Absolutely — children are very welcome. We cannot provide cots or extra beds, but besides the two bedrooms there is a sofa bed in the living room.

pets.a: No, unfortunately pets are not allowed in the apartment.

rules.a: The apartment is non-smoking, parties are not allowed, and quiet hours are from 10 pm to 8 am — the neighbours will thank you.

booking.q: How do I book and pay?
booking.a: Send us an inquiry with your dates. We confirm availability by e-mail or WhatsApp — no platform fees, and you pay nothing through the website. If you prefer, you can also book via Booking.com.
